visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a person's head while their hair is being lathered with shampoo. Two hands vigorously massage the scalp against a backdrop of grey tiles. (2) Exterior shot of a brightly lit storefront labeled 'Of cosmetics' in a modern urban setting. Inside, shelves are stocked with assorted bottles. (3) A woman sits in a salon chair with her back to the camera, showcasing her styled, wavy hair. Various product displays of hair care lines are shown. (4) Product application sequence: transparent liquid is pumped into a palm, then white cream is squeezed out and applied to the scalp and hair strands. (5) The woman uses a pink Dyson hairdryer to dry her hair, then holds up two product bottles ('1' and '2') smiling. (6) A giveaway packet and instructional text regarding trial packs are displayed against a shop window.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 日本髮廊都在用！可以塗頭皮的護髮. [Subtitle]: 影片未看，記得看到最後. (2) [Slogan]: 專業頭皮保養 髮根整個澎起來. (3) [Subtitle]: 來自日本專業髮廊 Of cosmetics 的頭髮保養系列. (4) [Logo]: Of cosmetics 表參道. (5) [Subtitle]: 我第一次在髮廊用到這個 直接就愛上了！ (6) [Subtitle]: Of cosmetics 在表參道有髮廊 可以直接去體驗洗髮 (需收費服務). (7) [Subtitle]: 洗完頭皮真的有被徹底淨化的感覺. (8) [Subtitle]: 外包裝上的數字 其實是使用步驟的標示！ (9) [Subtitle]: 玫瑰頭皮調理洗髮液 皂卷 這兩款適合所有頭皮類型 都帶有一點涼感洗起來很舒服. (10) [Subtitle]: 玫瑰草本香氣非常療癒 洗完頭皮像在深呼吸！ (11) [Subtitle]: 我覺得超神奇 洗完頭皮很乾淨，但髮尾不會乾！ (12) [Slogan]: 頭皮、髮絲 都可以用的護髮. (13) [Slogan]: 送禮物囉！ 底下任意留言 + 按讚 抽2位送出. (14) [Slogan]: 出示以下兌換券 免費領取試用包.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, cheerful acoustic-pop music with a female vocal begins. The rhythm is driven by light acoustic guitar and steady percussion. Faint sounds of water splashing and hair scrubbing are present in the mix. (2) The music continues without interruption. A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs as the scene shifts. (3) A distinct mechanical clicking sound is heard when the product pump is pressed, followed by a slight liquid squelch. The music maintains its high-energy, major-mode feel. (4) Short bursts of white noise from the hairdryer appear periodically, layered over the continuous musical track. (5) The track concludes with the female singer finishing a line, coinciding with the display of giveaway instructions.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Of cosmetics' hair care brand by demonstrating its usage and effectiveness, highlighting its salon origins in Japan, and encouraging audience engagement through a giveaway and trial offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of labeled products, verbal/text mention of brand benefits, visit to the flagship store, and giveaway promotion.
